from pathlib import Path
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":648,"var":"Q->north_square","code":"Q->north_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params, \"inorth_square\").i;","note":"The user-supplied projection string initializes the north-square configuration value."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":649,"var":"Q->south_square","code":"Q->south_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params, \"isouth_square\").i;","note":"The south-square configuration value is read from the same attacker-controlled input."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":652,"var":"Q->north_square","code":"if (Q->north_square < 0 || Q->north_square > 3) {","note":"The implementation validates the first square index and returns an error if it is outside 0..3."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":656,"var":"Q->south_square","code":"if (Q->south_square < 0 || Q->south_square > 3) {","note":"The implementation validates the second square index and returns an error if it is outside 0..3."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":473,"var":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)]","code":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)];","note":"If the checks were bypassed, the square values would influence the rotation-table index used to rearrange polar caps."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":65,"var":"rot[7][2][2]","code":"double rot[7][2][2] = ROT;","note":"The fixed-size rotation table would be the sink for an out-of-range lookup."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text('+proj=rhealpix +ellps=WGS84 +north_square=0 +south_square=0\n0 0\n')
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs')
p=subprocess.run([os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs','proj'), '+proj=rhealpix', '+ellps=WGS84', '+north_square=0', '+south_square=0'], input=b'0 0\n', env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout.decode())
